findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping in document lookups
findings.body: When tenants share the database, `getDocument` no longer passes `ctx.tenantId`, and this query filters only on attacker-controlled or colliding `documentId`. A request can therefore return another tenant's document; retain the tenant criterion in the loader contract and database lookup.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported cache module
findings.body: Deleting this file removes the exported `readCached` module path outright. Any consumer importing it now fails module resolution, which contradicts the stated goal of preserving existing contracts; keep a compatibility export or migrate consumers as part of the change.
